verses.text: So we must pay even closer attention to what we've heard, so we don't drift away.
If the message delivered through angels was reliable, and every violation or act of disobedience received a fair punishment,
how will we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? The Lord first announced it, and those who heard him confirmed it to us.
God also testified with them through signs, wonders, many kinds of miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, distributed according to his will.
God did not place the world to come, which we're talking about, under the rule of angels.
Someone testified somewhere: ‘What are humans that you remember them, or human beings that you care for them?
You made them a little lower than the angels; you crowned them with glory and honor.
You placed everything under their feet.’ Since God placed everything under them, nothing was left outside their rule. But we don't yet see everything under their rule.
But we do see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for a short time. Because he suffered death, he is now crowned with glory and honor. By God's grace, he tasted death for everyone.
God, for whom and through whom everything exists, chose to bring many children to glory. So it was fitting that he make the pioneer of their salvation complete through suffering.
The one who makes people holy and those who are made holy all have one Father. That's why Jesus isn't ashamed to call them brothers and sisters.
He says, ‘I will proclaim your name to my brothers and sisters; in the assembly I will sing your praise.’
Again he says, ‘I will trust him.’ And again, ‘Here I am with the children God has given me.’
Since the children share in flesh and blood, Jesus also shared in their humanity, so that through death he could destroy the one who held the power of death—the devil—
and free those who spent their whole lives trapped by fear of death.
Clearly, he doesn't help angels; he helps Abraham's descendants.
That's why he had to become like his brothers and sisters in every way, so he could be a merciful and faithful high priest in God's service and make atonement for the people's sins.
Since he suffered when he was tempted, he can help those who are being tempted.
